legacy_equivalence.method: Load baseline paper_signal_producer.py from git into a separate module; serialize complete old/new decisions including evaluated expression records on identical standalone/singleton inputs, for bullish/bearish/zero-momentum bars.
legacy_equivalence.probe_source:
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

from services.execution.lean_runtime.paper_signal_producer import CurrentArtifactStrategy
from services.execution.lean_runtime.test_portfolio_target_positions import cash_candidates, BUDGET
from services.execution.lean_runtime.test_current_artifact_signal import _binding
from services.registry.test_strategy_artifact import _artifact_with_expression_policy
from services.registry.test_portfolio_envelope import envelope, member_artifact

baseline = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "origin/dev"], text=True).strip()
old = Path("/tmp/persona-target-baseline-producer.py")
old.write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", baseline + ":services/execution/lean_runtime/paper_signal_producer.py"]))
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("persona_target_baseline_producer", old)
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
sys.modules[spec.name] = module
spec.loader.exec_module(module)

def result(strategy, binding):
    out = strategy(binding, "2026-11-13T06:00:00Z")
    expression = out.pop("expression", None)
    if expression:
        out["evaluated_expression"] = expression["evaluate"]()
        out["expression_view"] = expression["view"]
    return json.dumps(out, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False)

count = 0
for art in (member_artifact(), _artifact_with_expression_policy()):
    art["parameters"]["symbols"] = ["2330.TW"]
    for singleton in (False, True):
        artifact = envelope([{"member_id": "one", "artifact": art, "risk_weight": 1}]) if singleton else art
        for closes in ([100, 102], [102, 100], [100, 100]):
            binding = _binding(artifact, binding_id="legacy-check", include_market_input=False)
            binding["market_input"] = {"symbol": "2330.TW", "closes": closes,
                "event_time": "2026-11-13T05:30:00Z", "observed_at": "2026-11-13T06:00:00Z",
                "source_ref": "verification:unchanged-input"}
            kwargs = dict(expression_layer=True, candidates_builder=cash_candidates,
                          expression_inputs=lambda _: {"persona_book": {}, "risk_budget": BUDGET})
            assert result(CurrentArtifactStrategy(**kwargs), binding) == result(module.CurrentArtifactStrategy(**kwargs), binding)
            count += 1
print(json.dumps({"baseline": baseline, "byte_identical_decision_cases": count}))
